script: (() => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const accept = buttons.find((button) => /^accept$/i.test((button.textContent || '').trim())); if (accept) { accept.click(); return 'clicked-accept'; } for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.fixed.bottom-0, [role="dialog"]'))) { if (/cookies/i.test(el.textContent || '')) { el.remove(); return 'removed-cookie-ui'; } } return 'cookie-ui-not-found'; })()
